title: Enough Sun to Share
style: Acoustic summer punk, brisk strummed acoustic guitar driving a buoyant straight-ahead punk pulse, tight handclaps and light kit, warm melodic bass, occasional jangly electric-guitar accents. Scene-setting narrative verses build into a shout-along repeated chorus; raw, conversational male lead vocal with energetic gang harmonies on the hook. Sunlit, playful, slightly scrappy live-band feel, clear punchy mix.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Felicia on the park bench, red hair in the breeze
One white earbud in, a grin she can't conceal
Ruby at her nostril catching afternoon
She taps her blue-sweatpant knee and hums a tune

[Verse 2]
Gabriel's down on the grass beside his bike
Helmet tipped back, catching his breath in the light
Fifty-two and cooked from chasing every hill
She slips one earbud out: “Hey, you doing okay still?”

[Pre-Chorus]
He laughs, says, “Give me just a minute or two”
She offers her water; he says, “That'll do”
The park keeps moving, but they take their time
Two strangers sharing shade beneath the lime

[Chorus]
Hey, slow down, the day's not going anywhere
Take a seat, catch your breath, there's enough sun to share
You came in racing, now you're laughing with me
Summer's a little better when we let each other be

[Verse 3]
She tells him the song has a ridiculous line
He asks what it is, and she sings it off-time
He shakes his head, then gives the chorus a try
A cyclist rolls past with a wave and a sigh

[Pre-Chorus]
The water runs low and the afternoon leans
His bike waits beside them, bright spokes turning green
No grand revelation, no promise to keep
Just a bench, a small kindness, a breath running deep

[Chorus]
Hey, slow down, the day's not going anywhere
Take a seat, catch your breath, there's enough sun to share
You came in racing, now you're laughing with me
Summer's a little better when we let each other be

[Bridge]
When your legs give out and the whole world flies
A kind word can meet you right where you lie
No need to be heroes, no need to pretend
Just make a little room for a stranger and friend

[Final Chorus]
Hey, slow down, the day's not going anywhere
Take a seat, catch your breath, there's enough sun to share
You came in racing, now you're laughing with me
Summer's a little better when we let each other be

[Outro]
Felicia puts her earbud in, Gabriel stands up slow
They trade one last grin, then wherever they go
